name: Standing Cable Kickback
description: A triceps kickback performed standing upright with a low cable pulley attachment. The cable provides constant tension throughout the kickback motion unlike dumbbells which lose tension at the extended position. The standing position requires core stability.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Standing Cable Kickback in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Standing Cable Kickback.
steps: Step 1: Attach single handle to low pulley. Stand facing cable and hinge forward.
Step 2: Keep upper arm parallel to floor, elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Step 3: Extend elbow to kick arm back to full extension behind body.
Step 4: Hold peak position briefly then return to start.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Upper arm stays parallel to floor
